book.name: 1 Timoseo
book.title: Baluwa ja kutumbula jaka Paulo kwaka Timoseo

content: Kutumbula kwa mambu ghokapi, mumpwaghila Chapanga mambu ghamughapala, mundobha Chapanga, na mubhalobhila bhandu bhangi, na munchengula Chapanga kwa ndandi ja bhandu bhokapi.
Mubhalobhila bhakolongwa na bhandu bhokapi bhabhabhi na lujiniku, nahuli tupata kutama matamu gha kulijeka na gha lukwale, mu uhuhu wokapi na kunjojabhe Chapanga.
Lijambu aleli nde lambone na lunyambiha Chapanga, ambaju nde Mkengalela witu,
joapala bhandu bhokapi bhakengaliwaje na bhaumanya uchakaka.
Kwa ndandi kubhi na Chapanga jumu, na kubhi na jumu joabhajonganesha bhandu na Chapanga, mundu hoju nde Kristo Yesu,
joakalibhohiki mweni ngati nyambiku ja kubhakombola bhandu bhokapi. Ukombola hoghu sajenu ubhonikana kwa chikahi chaki.
Kwa ndandi jeniheji nepani nakahaghuliki kubha mtumi na mbola wa bhandu bha mataifa ghangi, na kubhatangazi bhandu ubholu wa uhobhalelu na uchakaka. Nongela chakaka, na wala ngachengolowa!
Bhela, kila pandu pamuhimangana kunjojabhe Chapanga, mbala akanalomi bhabhahenga ghamboni kwaka Chapanga bhajinula mabhoku ghabhu bhalobhaje, pangakubha na inyela wala kulochana.
Bhelabhela mbala akambomba bhawataje ingobhu ya utopelu, na bhawata wichu, nga kwa kuloka majunju, wala kulipamba kwa zahabu na lulu wala kwa ingobhu ya mbija yamaheli,
nambu bhabya na matendu ghambone, ngati moibhapalakila akambomba bhabhapwagha kubha bhunjojabhe Chapanga.
Mbomba na alibhola malobhi ghaka Chapanga kwa kutumbala chinunu na kuliheleha.
Nepani ngachenunjetake mbomba kubhola, wala kuntawala mwanalomi, nambu apalika kutama chinunu.
Kwa ndandi Adamu akabhombakiki hoti, na Eva panakatae.
Wala nga Adamu joakakoluwiki, nambu mbomba nde joakakoluwiki na kuheketa Shelia jaka Chapanga.
Hata bhela, mbomba anaakengaliwa kwa kubheleka bhana, ngati anabhajendali kutama mu uhobhalelu na ugholuleku, papamu na mtima wa wambone.
